name: Strait of Malacca
prelims: Crucial choke point between Pacific and Indian Oceans. Connects China, Japan, Korea to energy sources.
mains: Strategic significance in the 'Malacca Dilemma'. Discuss the significance of the kra isthmus canal project.
india: Vital for India's trade and energy security. Gateway to the South China Sea.

name: Chabahar Port
prelims: Port in Sistan-Baluchistan province of Iran. Located on the Gulf of Oman.
mains: Key node for the International North-South Transport Corridor (INSTC). Strategic response to Gwadar port.
india: India's gateway to Afghanistan and Central Asia, bypassing Pakistan.

name: Donbas Region
prelims: Industrial heartland in eastern Ukraine. Predominantly Russian-speaking area.
mains: Historical and demographic factors driving the separatist conflict since 2014. Key region in the Russia-Ukraine war.
india: India maintains a neutral stance, advocating for diplomacy and territorial integrity.
